category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
subcategory_text: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Annex A.5.15, Annex A.5.18, Annex A.8.2, Annex A.8.5
CRI Profile v2.0: PR.AA-01, PR.AA-01.01, PR.AA-01.02
implementation_examples: Initiate requests for new access or additional access for employees, contractors, and others, and track, review, and fulfill the requests, with permission from system or data owners when needed
Issue, manage, and revoke cryptographic certificates and identity tokens, cryptographic keys (i.e., key management), and other credentials
Select a unique identifier for each device from immutable hardware characteristics or an identifier securely provisioned to the device
Physically label authorized hardware with an identifier for inventory and servicing purposes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization.

Determine whether activities are conducted to initiate requests for new access or additional access for employees, contractors, and others, and track, review, and fulfill the requests, with permission from system or data owners when needed.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that issue, manage, and revoke cryptographic certificates and identity tokens, cryptographic keys (i.e., key management), and other credentials.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
